newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct after meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct after meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its three-member policy-setting board.
"No change," an SNB spokesman said in answer to an enquiry after today's meeting.
No rate change was expected. The SNB last lowered the discount rate to 1.00 percent from 1.50 percent on September 26. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
